verdict.rationale: The evidence pack describes selecting from 5k+ pre-built voices and voice customization (speed, multi-voice switching) but contains no mention of a voice-cloning feature for creating a custom brand voice, nor any documented consent process for cloning (e.g., voice verification, spoken consent statement) required by ElevenLabs' broader platform. Missing for 10: any docs on voice cloning/Instant or Professional Voice Cloning for Agents, and any consent-verification workflow.
